sentences.en: That topic is too intimate to share with casual acquaintances.
sentences.zh: 这个话题太私人了，不适合和普通朋友分享。

sentences.en: He intimated that all is not well in his marriage.
sentences.zh: 他暗示他的婚姻出了问题。

sentences.en: Sami didn't want his relationship with Layla to be intimate.
sentences.zh: 萨米不想和他的莱拉关系过于亲密。

senses.zh: 有紧密联系的，亲密无间的：close association；不为人知的：not known；密友：
